notes.title: Viking Heroes 5 is out now!
notes.notes:
Embark on a festive journey as Everand, Brunnhilde, Helga, and Boromere prepare for Yule! Amidst enchanting festivities, the Viking siblings discover Odin has lost control over his vision of time and the threads of fate, prompting a mysterious journey throughout the famous realms of the nine worlds.

It is up to you to help the vikings rediscover the lost Rune of Balance to restore order to the nine worlds. The vikings will have to confront mystical challenges and unveil the truth of their surroundings. They will battle powerful adversaries and team with old and new companions alike. Though not all may be as they seem. 

Download now to guide the Viking heroes through illusions, confront powerful adversaries, and claim Odin's extraordinary gifts, shaping their legendary fate!

notes.title: Golden Rails: Harvest of Riddles is out now!
notes.notes:
A new adventure awaits in Golden Rails: Harvest of Riddles. Join the dynamic duo, Jack and Jill, once again as they answer the call of another mayor that is seeking help to organize a grand fair.
The mayor has big plans for the town, and it's up to you to assist Jack and Jill in making them a reality. You'll be tasked with transporting the bountiful harvest of vegetables and repairing old railways to ensure the festival's success.
Delve deeper into the story and you'll uncover a web of intrigue and deceit; stumble upon dark secrets; contraband hidden among the cargo; and a conspiracy that threatens the entire festival. 
You, alongside Jack and Jill, will need to piece together the puzzle, find the mastermind behind the scheme, and bring them to justice. 
Golden Rails 6 is an adventure packed with mystery, intrigue, and unexpected twists. Can you uncover the truth and save the day? The time has come to harvest the truth and restore order. Join Jack and Jill in their latest adventure now!

notes.title: Incredible Dracula: Dark Carnival is out now!
notes.notes:
In Incredible Dracula Dark Carnival you’ll face a magical conundrum like no other! Elizabeth, Dracula’s beloved wife, has been cursed by the mischievous and legendary magician, Bestby. Her head was transformed into a pumpkin, and Dracula must embark on a quest to break the curse before it's too late.
Bestby awakens only sporadically, but each time he does, he wreaks havoc and seeks extravagant celebrations. This time, he's chosen Halloween as his backdrop, and he's demanding a grand feast that the entire county will remember.
You will step into the shoes of Dracula, determined to meet Bestby's demands and break the curse. Your journey will find you needing to create a Halloween extravaganza filled with zombies, spiderwebs, scary pumpkins, and all things eerie to satisfy Bestby's whims.
But it won't be a walk in the park. Bestby has accumulated immense magical power over the centuries, making breaking the curse a daunting task. You'll need to gather resources and undertake various challenges to create the perfect feast. Along the way, you'll encounter the many inhabitants of the county and explore many areas, all while racing against the clock.
As you work tirelessly to organize an unforgettable Halloween feast, Elizabeth’s fate hangs in the balance. Can you meet Bestby's demands, break the curse, and ensure that Dracula’s wife returns to her true form? Dive into the enchanting world of Incredible Dracula Dark Carnival and find out!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/11774005/289d71475c6fe1066d7971270390d24c1ba32945.png[/img]

notes.title: Claire's Cruisin' Cafe Fest Frenzy is out now!
notes.notes:
Join Claire and her adventurous brother, Frank, as they embark on a journey of culinary discovery! It's the first day of the festival, and they need your help to run their food truck successfully.
Step into Claire's shoes and take charge of the food truck, serving a variety of mouthwatering dishes to the festival-goers. With Frank's enthusiastic photography skills, capture those happy customer moments to share on your popular blog, gaining fans and followers along the way!
As the story progresses, you'll encounter a series of challenges and surprises. Help Claire manage the food truck as customers flood in! You'll need to swiftly take orders, cook up delicious dishes, and serve them with a smile.
Immerse yourself in the warmth of family ties and the excitement of the festival atmosphere in Claire’s Cruisin’ Cafe 3. Start your culinary journey now and make every moment count!

notes.title: Rescue Team Mineral of Miracles is out now!
notes.notes:
In the small town of Stonecane, the extraordinary discovery of a mineral named "Immortalite" has sent shockwaves across the globe. Acting with the newly-founded Immortalite Research Group, you are tasked with uncovering the secrets of this powerful substance and ensuring it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.
Lead a team of specialists, including the brilliant geologist Charlotte Stone and the tech-savvy John, to navigate through a web of intrigue and peril. A clandestine organization with nefarious intentions has already begun illegally mining and processing Immortalite and so your mission is clear – to dismantle their operation, neutralize the threat, and safeguard the world from the potential catastrophic consequences.
Play Rescue Team: Mineral of Miracles now and piece together clues, hack encrypted data, and interrogate captured diggers to unravel the sinister plot behind it all.

notes.title: New Yankee: Mary's Dark Side is out now!
notes.notes:
The bond between John and Mary, legendary travelers between worlds, is unbreakable. They embark on adventures together, supporting each other and hosting vibrant themed parties. But their lives take an unexpected turn when Mary's memory is lost, and she awakens with a much darker concept of herself.
Now, it’s up to John and his companions to rescue Mary from herself, as well as retrieve King Arthur’s crown. Together, they’ll face mysterious symbols, magical traps, and elusive creatures while uncovering the truth behind Mary's actions. With Max's instincts leading the way, they’ll stumble upon unexpected obstacles, from enchanted trees to elusive unicorns. Despite the challenges, they’ll remain determined to find Mary and bring her back to her senses. As they navigate through perilous trials, their resolve will be tested, and their friendship will grow stronger.
Are you ready for a timeless adventure of magic, friendship, and destiny? Join John and friends in an epic quest to restore Mary's memories, and safeguard the future of their world now!

notes.title: Hermes: The Fury of Megaera is out now!
notes.notes:
An ancient rivalry resurfaces. Meet Megaera, a vengeful being with a dark past. Banished and feared, she found solace in her ominous lair, surrounded by suffering and horror. Fueled by resentment and a thirst for power, she has set her sights on Aphrodite, the embodiment of beauty and allure.
Megaera's malevolent plan unfolds as she unveils her scheme to transform Aphrodite into a lifeless stone sculpture. The festival becomes a battleground between good and evil, and the fate of Aphrodite hangs in the balance.
Hermes must venture deep into the heart of Megaera's lair to find her. Along the way, he’ll face challenges, encounter strange creatures, and unravel the truth behind Aphrodite's disappearance. With each step, the mystery deepens, and the danger intensifies.
As the pieces of the puzzle come together, Hermes seeks aid from his fellow gods and goddesses. Together, they must confront Megaera, halt her nefarious plans, and rescue Aphrodite before it's too late.
Prepare to be enthralled by stunning landscapes, face formidable foes, and engage in strategic battles. Uncover hidden secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and restore harmony to the realms. The fate of Olympus and the very essence of beauty itself rest in your hands. Will you rise to the challenge, join the gods and goddesses in their quest, and become a hero of legend? The time to act is now. Download and embark on this extraordinary journey. The Summer Solstice Festival awaits, and the destiny of Aphrodite hangs in the balance.

notes.notes:

As the sun and moon falter and Fenrir, the giant wolf, threatens to consume them, the Vikings must travel across realms to forge a new and magical chain that can capture him. However, the journey will not be easy as they face dangerous enemies, including Fenrir's sons, despicable forces that watch their every move. With the help of the gods, they will embark on a quest filled with action and adventure across various realms to restore light to the world.
